data.title: Jobcenter invitation to appointment on 22 April 2026
data.summary: Jobcenter Musterlingen invites Lea Muster to a meeting on 22 April 2026 at 8:15 about her current professional situation. She should bring her CV.
data.explanation: This is a mandatory invitation (Meldeaufforderung) from the Jobcenter. You must attend the appointment in room 1.18 with Ms Petzold and bring your CV (Lebenslauf). If you miss it without an important reason, your Bürgergeld will be reduced by 10 percent of the standard rate for one month. If you cannot attend for an important reason, contact the Jobcenter as early as possible, using the phone number on the letter.
